description:
Role:  PowerBuilder
 Location : Richmond, VA
 Duration : 6+ Months
  
 Job description: 
  Responsibilities 
 • Design, Develop and Maintain complex business applications
 • Create and update documentation for applications to include reference, user documentation, solutions delivery, requirements, logic, flow charts and design
 • Coaching of users in application operations
 • Provide problem analysis and resolution
 • Mentoring others
 • Other duties as required
  Skills 
 • Strong demonstrated experience in developing business applications using Power Builder
 • Strong demonstrated experience writing reports in Power Builder
 • Strong demonstrated experience with Oracle database
 • Strong demonstrated experience writing database scripts, SQL statements, stored procedures, functions, views, etc.
 • Understanding of network environment
 • Ability to work independently or with a team to develop applications in a multi-tier environment.
 • Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering and interpreting user needs
 • Aptitude to understand and document interdependences between systems for integrations.
 • Demonstrated experience with Web Development experience in developing in N-tiered application/web-based object oriented environment using J2EE, JSP, JavaScript, SQL, HTML and XML, Spring, Hibernate, Struts, JDBC , Multithreading, JQuery, AJAX, Web Services, Java Servlets, and PL/SQL. (Preferred, not required)
  Preferred Qualifications 
 • 5+ years of experience with Power Builder
 • 2+ years of experience with Web Java Development
 • Associates degree or higher
 • Related Certifications
 • Agile Experience
 • Verbal and Written Communication Skills
